sukuk_source: Listed-market proxy only: total listed Sukuk/Bonds issuance size observed from Saudi Exchange/Tadawul annual reporting; conventional component treated as the listed FRN block (SAR 22.535bn) visible in the 2025 Saudi Exchange Sukuk/Bonds list; sukuk = total - FRNs. This is not a full corporate listed + unlisted stock split. Total source: Saudi Tadawul Group Annual Report 2024 for 2021-2024 (reported Sukuk/Bonds issuance sizes), Saudi Exchange Sukuk/Bonds Annual Report 2025 for 2025. 2025 source: https://www.saudiexchange.sa/Resources/Reports-v2/FI_Annually_en.html
